page.title: Galactic Occupations
page.t: Operating range (0 = home sector; 99 = entire connected galaxy)
Preferred faction: select one of its ships/stations
Escort an active commercial voyage to its actual destination. Custom service contract.

Transport up to ten real NPC passengers, limited by free crew berths. Normal booked delivery pays 8,000 Cr each. Removing the persistent taxi service starts a thirty-game-minute unpaid departure grace; temporary orders retain passengers.
Close component surveys with surface approaches and ten seconds of clear line of sight. Publish native per-component scan data at the player scanner cap.
Explore connections, catalogue anomalies and their actual destination lists.

Board up to ten real passengers; new tours default to twenty distinct galaxy sights before booked drop-off. Default luxury fare: 500,000 Cr each. Cancelled tours leave unpaid after at least two game hours; ordinary interruptions retain the party.

Harvest real loaded crystals with weapons or turrets; simulate resource-backed mining off screen across the galaxy. Automatically sell at dockable faction stations and pay credits to the player. All normal armed ship sizes; no mineral hold required.
Provoke a manageable hostile and retreat to a stronger friendly force. Detect pursuit and abandon failed attempts.
Shoot actual destructible asteroids. High attention required for physical firing.
Improve eligible crew morale, with ship and faction cooldowns. Reputation requires actual improvement.
Perform the timed NPC cargo-inspection equivalent under local jurisdiction. Report contraband without forcing hostility.
Attempt surrender of capturable, non-mission hostile ships below 25 percent hull; preserve hull, equipment and crew.
Follow real trader destinations, escort traffic and intercept manageable threats along its route.

Galaxy-wide station hacking using an existing crew member or captain. Requires actual hacking tools from player inventory; missing tools retry every 10 game minutes. Crew must walk to a native panel and return before departure. No employer or automatic payment.
Queue one physical crew hack of the selected native station panel. Existing orders and default behaviour are retained.
Off-screen crystal items per full batch
